brief.audience: Young professionals, expats and tourists who hang out in Downtown Dubai’s specialty‑coffee scene. They frequent spots like The Coffee Lab (social, morning‑time crowd) and Roasters Specialty Coffee House (board‑games, coffee‑and‑tea lovers) and often combine a coffee break with a quick view of the Burj Khalifa, so they value a modern, Instagram‑ready vibe and enjoy global music and lifestyle brands.

menu.idea: Date‑spiced oat‑milk flat white with a hint of rose water, served with a mini almond‑date pastry.
menu.why: The “Specialty Coffee” tag shows the audience seeks high‑quality, innovative coffee drinks, while Dubai coffee‑goers love local flavours such as dates and floral notes.

menu.idea: Cold brew tonic with hibiscus syrup and a splash of pomegranate, topped with edible gold dust.
menu.why: The Coffee Lab’s “Yacht club view” and “Social” tags indicate a preference for refreshing, visually striking drinks that suit a sunny, upscale setting.

menu.idea: Signature “Burj Breeze” espresso martini mocktail (espresso, cardamom‑infused milk, sparkling water, a dash of orange blossom).
menu.why: The proximity to Burj Khalifa (tags “Bustling”, “City view”) suggests guests enjoy sophisticated, non‑alcoholic cocktails that echo the city’s skyline vibe.
